title: Protected whole-book incumbent comparator
question: Can the optimized protected comparator publish the complete book and deliver the witnessed repairs to ordinary source consumers?
method: Verify retained source and recognition, run one protected full comparator, then adopt the exact publication for the release-pinned formula projection. Compare Reader, source search and proposal packet results.

outputs.role: Exact protected pins, witnessed Reader results, bounded timing and projection consumer receipt

results.name: verified recognition replay
results.note: CPU replay from exact retained source and recipe

conclusion: Run 377 published the full repaired comparator and run 378 adopted its exact pin. The source-witnessed caption, table and formula reached the ordinary Reader. The p416 projection, source search and native proposal packet carried the verified original. Full-book Chandra shadow qualification remains separate.
